'''Infrared-rated constable''' was the lowest rank in the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. Infrared-rated constables were [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] within the organization, which was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] arm of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]&mdash;the rulers the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. As with the other eight ranks of the Sullustan Constable Brigade, infrared-rated constable shared its name with one of the bands of the spectrum of light.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of infrared-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
